_about: Public-domain Eleazar Wheelock (1711-1779), founder of Moor's Indian Charity School and Dartmouth College, for the Word Hoard: A Plain and Faithful Narrative of the Indian Charity-School at Lebanon (Boston, 1763) and his Continuations of the Narrative (Boston, 1765; and to the incorporation with Dartmouth, 1771), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 39 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

wheelock-plain-narrative-1763: A plain and faithful Narrative of the Indian Charity-School at Lebanon, in Connecticut (Boston: Richard and Samuel Draper, M.DCC.LXIII)
wheelock-continuation-1765: A Continuation of the Narrative of the Indian Charity-School, from Nov. 27th, 1762, to Sept. 3d, 1765 (Boston: Richard and Samuel Draper, 1765)
wheelock-continuation-1771: A Continuation of the Narrative of the Indian Charity-School, from the Year 1768 to the Incorporation of it with Dartmouth-College (printed in the year 1771)

_alternates.wheelock-copies: Other 1763 copies (and PG 46378); the 1773 Continuation (title page unreadable); the Rochester Reprints facsimiles

_excluded.wheelock-other: The London 1767 and 1769 Narratives, which name him as founder, not author (credited to Nathaniel Whitaker)
